sourceDesign.exportCommand: Pencil MCP only: copy docs/design/padel-friend.pen to a scratch file, then execute({ filePath: <scratch>, input: 'Export(["wHaAb","vAxZh","b5RR4","RDV2r","JLqMT","eYIgj","ENn8Q","kYI9H","uePpj","w25dY","Fyhbv","t1ywa","n6zFq"], "png", <scratch>/refs, {scale:1})' }); copy/rename exports into e2e/references/paf-4/ with the named references below. The encrypted source .pen is never read or grepped by other tooling.
sourceDesign.provenanceNote: All 13 PAF-4 frames verified present in the current design (sha256 above) and exported at scale 1 (390-wide phone frames) from a temporary copy, so the source design stayed untouched. Double export of wHaAb/ENn8Q/eYIgj reproduced byte-identical PNGs. Frames taller than 844px (wHaAb 916, eYIgj 872, ENn8Q 920) are cropped to the top 390x844 viewport region; below-the-fold layout of those frames is covered by structural probes instead of pixel comparison. n6zFq (Shared screen states) is a 431x561 board of compact patterns, not a full screen: it is exported for provenance and drives structural assertions only, never a pixel budget.

recorded-empty-available.response.json.what: Byte-exact list_match_events(entry=available) server-function response captured after the same prune e2e/global-setup.ts performs (zero match events in the local loopback database).
recorded-empty-available.response.json.why: Available is a global listing; once any public event exists it cannot be truthfully emptied inside a combined suite run. The suite replays this recorded response at the network boundary so the empty-state rendering (real application code) is deterministic in any run order.

maskedAreas.policy: Masks cover only genuinely dynamic areas: venue-photo renderings (main img) and rendered start-instant text lines (first paragraph of each card / of the detail page / the review cutoff line). Whole fields, cards or sections are never masked.

scopeAdaptations.summary: The T04 implementation deliberately renders a strict subset of the designer frames. These omissions are scope-aligned adaptations recorded here and in the plan — not hidden visual defects — and the first-honest-comparison budgets below reflect them.
items: No Ranked/Unranked competition-status control and no Eligible League block (wHaAb, RDV2r, JLqMT): T04 has no Ranked/League state.
No public-match label on the 'Open to community' row (wHaAb): the visibility control offers exactly community_open and invite_only.
No filter chips (THIS WEEK/COMPETITIVE/MY LEVEL, This week/All types selects) on Available (ENn8Q, kYI9H): the listing contract has no filter set.
No date group headers or 'N open' counters on Available (ENn8Q): no fake counters.
No VIEW MATCH per-card action (ENn8Q): the whole card title is the link.
No SAVE control on create frames (wHaAb, vAxZh, b5RR4, RDV2r): wizard state is form-only; there are no persisted drafts.
No team assignment, no group format block (b5RR4): step 3 is the team-mode choice only.
No SET LIMIT / registration-order panel (vAxZh): maximum is a plain field and the FIFO rule renders as informational copy.
No photo hero overlay with venue name/description (JLqMT, eYIgj): detail renders the required photo, datetime, Maps link, price and notes as semantic fields.
No participants roster/grid or reserve queue (JLqMT, eYIgj): T04 shows accepted/playing/reserve/groups/more-needed counts only; detailed participant profiles are deferred.

No JOIN COMMUNITY TO PLAY / REQUEST TO PLAY registration actions (JLqMT, eYIgj) and no ACCEPT/DECLINE invitation actions (Fyhbv): T05 owns registration; T04 renders truthful informational approval/invitation context instead.
No result review, disputed/canceled/confirmed records or status variants beyond INVITED/RESERVE (uePpj, w25dY, t1ywa): T04 renders scheduled history only and never fabricates results.

No bottom navigation (Home/Matches/Community/Ranking/Profile) on any frame: the existing shell intentionally keeps working Matches/dashboard links instead of drawing inert destinations for screenshot parity.
The real shell renders language and theme selects above main; the design frames show neither (they show a LIGHT badge).

kYI9H 'Explore public communities' block and '+ CREATE A MATCH' action: out of T04 scope; the app renders the localized empty copy only (the missing in-app create entry link is a reported gap in the functional suite).

sub44pxHitTargets: Detail share-URL readonly input renders at 26px height (unstyled native input).
Create Details venue-photo native file input renders at 24px height (unstyled).
Team-mode radio labels and invitee 'Remove' buttons are unstyled and render below 44px height (measured values are attached to the test runs).
The unavailable state's Back link renders unstyled at 20px, while the loaded detail's Back link uses the shared 56px link style.
knownDeviations.focusRing: The token focus ring is --border-width-md (1.5px), which Chromium renders as 1px at 1x; the design states board (n6zFq) calls for a 2px visible ring. The ring is visible (solid green) and the measured value is attached to every keyboard-reachability probe; widening the token belongs to the owning UI unit.
knownDeviations.tabAriaCurrent: Non-current tabs inherit TanStack Link's default fuzzy active matching, so /matches/my also marks the Available tab with aria-current='page'. Exactly-one-current-tab behavior requires exact matching in MatchesPage (owning unit: PAF-75).
knownDeviations.wizardPhotoPreview: The create Details/Review photo previews render the raw staging object key as the img src (resolves to a route URL, naturalWidth 0, 20px alt-text box) instead of a signed URL, and carry no 16/9 treatment; the design frame shows a proper photo row. The card/detail images use signed URLs with the 16/9 cover treatment and are probed exactly.
knownDeviations.note: All measured values are attached to the test runs (attachments '<label> — sub-44px controls (known deviations)', 'tab <name> — stray aria-current (known deviation)', '<label> — measured focus ring'). Fixes belong to the owning UI unit (PAF-75); they are exempted from the gates with explicit named exceptions, never hidden.

visualBudgets.policy: Reference-backed budgets equal the measured first honest app-vs-Pencil diff ratio plus a margin that only absorbs cross-platform font-rasterization residuals (PAF-1 measured ~0.75-1.3pp absolute on text-dense screens): +2pp for glyph-dominated screens (<20% measured), +1.5pp for layout-block-dominated screens (>=20%). Self-baselined viewports/locales/states keep a 2pp envelope around their first honest capture. Margins are never widened to hide a structural defect; structure is asserted exactly by the probes.
visualBudgets.calibration: Measured on macOS (deviceScaleFactor 1) against the byte-identical double-exported Pencil references with only genuinely dynamic areas masked (venue photo renderings, rendered start-instant lines). Run with VISUAL_CALIBRATE=1 to re-measure; regular runs are hard gates.
